items.content:
Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
GAME: Stardew Valley, Research Farm. Wed Spring 3, Year 1. Current time: ~2:30 pm (time advances ~10 min per real ~7s regardless of action; only farmer sprite/camera position change proves movement). Gold: 450g. Energy: ~113/270 (healthy). Rain day (crops auto-watered).

CONTROLS (confirmed):
- WASD moves farmer when focus is live. Focus drops every 1-2 actions.
- Left-click on open ground/weed tile restores focus (sometimes also pathfinds farmer toward that tile, advancing clock).
- Fiber tooltip or pathfinding orange arrow = focus is live.
- Number keys select toolbar slot AND exit furniture placement mode.
- Escape = opens inventory (does NOT cancel furniture placement or dismiss obstacle dialogs).
- Left-click on stumps/logs with axe selected = 'axe not strong enough' dialog. Dismiss: left-click on dialog text at x0.50,y0.885 OR X button at x0.962,y0.885. Escape does NOT close it.
- Left-click near farmhouse furniture = picks up into furniture placement mode (AVOID).
- Clock advance alone does NOT prove movement; only farmer sprite position change or camera pan proves it.

INVENTORY: Slot1=axe, slot2=hoe, slot3=watering can, slot4=pickaxe, slot5=scythe (currently selected), slot6=stone(8), slot7=fiber, slot8=empty, slot9=TV furniture item, slot11=wood(4). Slot 5 scythe currently selected.

CURRENT POSITION: Farmer at ~x0.58,y0.37 on the farm, in the southern section past the main obstacle cluster. Facing south. Camera shows open sandy ground with green cross weeds (passable) extending south. Farm south exit still below current view.

FARM LAYOUT (observed):
- Farmhouse south wall exit notch at ~x0.47,y0.87. NEVER left-click near farmhouse furniture (TV, chair, backpack, plant) — triggers furniture placement mode.
- Pond at ~x0.65-0.92,y0.44-0.68 (original coordinates near farm center). Pond touches east tree wall — NO east corridor south.
- Large stumps (round brown base, copper axe NOT strong enough — triggers dialog): one at ~x0.72-0.78,y0.25-0.30, one at ~x0.46,y0.52 area. AVOID clicking near these with any tool.
- Fallen logs (brown horizontal): also trigger 'not strong enough' dialog with copper axe. Logs at ~x0.53,y0.55 and ~x0.68,y0.47 near current position. AVOID clicking near these.
- Small green pine saplings: copper axe CAN chop them (confirmed: chopped one sapling blocking south, gained 4 wood). Multiple hits needed.
- Rocks: pickaxe (slot 4) breaks them in one hit (yielded 8 stone each). Rocks at ~x0.65,y0.17 east; more scattered ahead.
- Green cross weeds: fully PASSABLE — farmer walks through them freely.
- East boundary tree wall at x0.92+.
- East boundary fence with purple flowers at x0.87-0.90 near current position.

ROUTE TAKEN (observed): Farmhouse -> farm open area -> got stuck against east wall -> routed WEST around pond -> navigated through obstacle cluster (stumps, pines, sapling, logs, rocks) by combination of S+D diagonals, auto-pathfinding clicks, chopping a blocking sapling, and breaking blocking rocks -> now in southern open farm section at x0.58,y0.37 heading south.

CURRENT OBSTACLES AHEAD: Fallen logs at ~x0.53,y0.55 and ~x0.68,y0.47 (avoid clicking). Green cross weeds (passable). Last action: left-click at x0.55,y0.55 to restore focus with scythe selected — result not yet confirmed.

ACTIVE GOALS:
1. Exit farm south boundary (farm exit location not yet confirmed by observation).
2. Head east via dirt road to bus stop then Pelican Town.
3. Continue 'Introductions' quest (greeted Emily, Gus, Pam, Shane so far, ~4/28 total).
4. Check mailbox (unread letter visible at farmhouse).

FAILED/SLOW STRATEGIES:
- Holding S without prior focus restore: no movement.
- Clicking brown dirt at x0.78,y0.38: hits stump.
- Clicking in pond: no pathfinding (impassable).
- S hold trying to pass pine sapling directly (same x): blocked for 30+ turns until sapling was chopped.
- S+D diagonal alone without focus: lost focus before registering.
- Escape to cancel furniture mode: opens inventory instead.
- Right-click to cancel furniture mode: moves ghost instead.

UNRESOLVED:
- Exact farm south exit location not confirmed by observation (believed to be south boundary below current position).
- Whether more large obstacles (stumps, logs, pines) block the remaining south path is unknown.
- Farmhouse mailbox letter contents unknown.
- NPC introduction count: ~4 of 28 confirmed by observation.
